title: The plain bag
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The dog-food letter. Wood feeds the pup from a bag with no logo.

panels.composition: The garage. A letter open on the table — a hardware chain's logo, a photo of a dog-food bag with a stick figure and a rotor on it, mocked up. WOOD. BARNABY II at his bowl.
props: letter with a mock-up of a dog-food bag

image.prompt: a man at a drafting table reading a letter that includes a printed mock-up of a dog-food bag bearing a stick figure with a helicopter rotor, a three-legged dog at a bowl nearby, clean ink

panels.composition: The mock-up. The stick figure. Under it, in the mock-up's font: BARNABY'S CHOICE.

image.prompt: close-up of a printed mock-up of a pet-food bag with a crude stick figure and a brand name in a cheerful font
image.notes: BARNABY'S CHOICE. Letter after. They used the dog's name.

panels.composition: Wood folding the letter into eighths. Looking at the drafting table's leg. It already has one.

characters.pose: folding, looking at the table leg

image.prompt: a man folding a letter into a small square while looking at a drafting table leg that already has a folded letter wedged under it

panels.composition: The pup eating from a plain brown paper bag with no logo, the kibble poured straight from it. Wood watching. The folded letter in the wastebasket with the trench coat's ghost.

image.prompt: a three-legged dog eating kibble poured from a plain brown paper bag with no logo, a man watching, a folded letter in a wicker wastebasket, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: BARNABY'S CHOICE. Refused. The plain bag.
